quarterly_data.signal: Power Integrations' 10-K lists customers representing 10% or more of net revenue: Avnet at 32% in 2025 (30% in 2024, 27% in 2023), Salcomp Group at 11% in 2025 (below 10% in 2024, 10% in 2023) and Honestar Technologies Co., Ltd. below 10% in 2025 (11% in 2024, 18% in 2023). Its top ten customers, including distributors, accounted for approximately 81%, 79% and 80% of net revenue in 2025, 2024 and 2023, and sales to distributors were $304.6 million in 2025.
